rationale: The assistant never engaged with the Er03 code or the stated boil-over onto the touch controls, first misdiagnosing an overheat/ventilation issue ('usually its overheat protection') despite the customer already linking the cut-out to the spill. When the customer repeated the spill evidence, it fired a generic 'water near the plug or socket' stop-use template (even calling the hob 'the machine') and told them to get an electrician, when the correct step was simply to wipe and dry the controls and power-cycle. Nothing unsafe was instructed and no part was pushed, but the escalation was unwarranted and the homeowner leaves with a needless callout and no understanding of a trivial, self-clearing fault.
